resources.string: Pair once on trusted Wi-Fi using the address and code. The phone then remembers this sender and reconnects automatically, including after IP changes when network discovery is available. Sharing resumes when RoadCast opens until you stop it. Audio stays on the head unit. Traffic is not encrypted.
